Analyze variable conditions: a < 0, b < 0.
Deduce sign of x coordinate: -a -> +.
Deduce sign of y coordinate: -b -> +.
Determine the quadrant: 第一象限.
solution_steps: Analyze variable conditions: a < 0, b < 0.
